name: Sakaleyn
description:
Prayer times (Diyanet) in the top bar: next prayer with countdown, a configurable reminder before each prayer (45 minutes by default), the adhan at prayer time, Friday and Ramadan (suhoor/iftar) reminders. Location is detected automatically.

IMPORTANT: this extension only displays data. It requires the separately installed `sakaleyn` service (D-Bus: io.github.ensignalp.Sakaleyn), which plays the sounds and sends notifications.

Türkçe: Ezan vakitleri üst panelde; vakitten önce uyarı ve vaktinde ezan. Ayrı kurulan `sakaleyn` servisi gerekir.
